Usage: rhythm sightread doctor [--offline] [--json]

Checks what a review needs: each source answers, the npm registry's signing keys
load and match the set pinned in this build, the cache folder is writable,
GITHUB_TOKEN is set (and how many GitHub requests are left), git is on PATH and,
when the config has a soundcheck section, rhythm-soundcheck and rhythm-roadie
are installed. --offline skips the network checks. Exit 1 when a check fails.

Flags:
  --json      print the kind doctor JSON document
  --offline   skip the network checks (also RHYTHM_OFFLINE)
  --plain     no symbols or colour (also when stdout is not a terminal)

Examples:
  rhythm sightread doctor
  rhythm sightread doctor --offline --json
